title: 彭博社Olivia Solon：Fear扩展行为涉嫌欺诈，违反服务条款
speaker: Olivia Solon

segments.en: So it was kind of getting a commission for a sale that would have happened anyway. And we tested this across more than 50 retailers websites and found it was consistently happening over our testing period of, it was a little over a week long.
segments.zh: 它实际上是在为本来就会发生的销售获取佣金。我们在超过50家零售商网站上进行了测试，发现这种情况在整个测试期间（一周多一点）持续发生。

segments.en: Olivia, this Christina used the word fraud a moment ago. This has a whiff of fraud to it. It does seem like it's in violation of terms of service.
segments.zh: Olivia，Christina刚才用了“欺诈”这个词。这确实有欺诈的味道，似乎违反了服务条款。

segments.en: When you look at the potential illegality of this, what do we find here? Were they kind of circumventing rules, doing something kind of an enterprising practice to be most charitable sort of? Where does this fall in the spectrum of online fraud?
segments.zh: 从潜在违法性来看，我们发现了什么？他们是在规避规则，还是说好听点是一种进取的做法？这在网络欺诈中属于什么程度？
